surfaces.underground:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a hand-painted 2D side-view platformer, actual transparent PNG background. Match the reference's fine inked handpainted rock and woody root style, highly detailed readable material. Output 2048 x 2048 atlas.
LAYOUT: at upper center, a completely OPAQUE PERFECT SQUARE material sample occupying about 900x900 pixels. The material inside the square MUST fill to every one of its four straight sides, no vignette, no rounded corners, no holes, no empty alpha, no exterior rim, no grass protruding. Viewed as a cross section side-on, flat ambient lighting. Below this square put exactly FOUR separate isolated horizontal ONE-WAY JUMP PLATFORM SPRITES in four stacked rows. Their lengths must be in exact ratio 1:2:3:4, widest about1400px. Their thickness must all be the SAME 150px maximum, flat clearly defined walkable horizontal top edge, chunky small rockwood underside tapering slightly, no long hanging roots. Each platform has its own specifically drawn silhouette and details, not a stretched copy. They should look like narrow floating rock-root shelves in strict 2D side view. They each float alone on transparent background, enough clear gaps between rows, no shadows on background, no labels or grids or text. All surfaces read at small scale, sharp material details, no blur, no perspective/isometric view. Do not draw characters, buildings, logos or scenery.
THEME: Underground biome palette: rich warm earthen browns, ochre pebbles, dark umber roots and layered soil with small tan fossils, no green lawn. Platform surfaces are earthy rock held by gnarled dry roots, narrow golden brown moss at flat top.

water: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 8 frame sprite animation atlas for a hand-painted 2D side-view game. Primary request: directional water attack spray that visibly shoots toward the RIGHT. Real transparent background. Layout exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, equal cells, eight distinct animation frames in reading order, large clear gutters, no labels, no grid or text. Request high-resolution 2048x1024. Each frame is an isolated crisp luminous cyan-white splash, fluid ink-painted highlights and translucent blue water, always at the same source pivot at cell leftbottom quarter, flat horizontal waterline. Sequence: 1 tiny burst fanning right, 2 strong broad rightward jet arcing slightly up, 3 long forceful rightward sheet with many directional droplets, 4 sheet breaks up into right-moving arcs and beads, 5 outward scattered rightward droplets start falling, 6 fewer droplets and thin curved spray, 7 tiny falling droplets, 8 final few fading beads. Water jets must clearly travel horizontally toward RIGHT, NOT a circular upward fountain, no characters, no pool scenery, no splash on ground, no black outlines, no opaque backdrop. Keep spray safely within each equal cell, do not let adjacent frames touch. White brightest center with subtle pale blue transparent edges, thin expressive fluid shapes.
